description: This script manages the restart and status check of hotspot-related services, specifically handling hostapd service restart, configuration, and interface management based on the activation status of the hotspot, utilizing commands like ifconfig, ps, grep, and hostapd.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd service by killing existing processes and bringing network interfaces down and up, then starting hostapd with a specific configuration.

methods.name: Hostapd_Restart
methods.description: Kills hostapd processes and resets network interfaces, preparing for a restart.
